title: Ad Copy Variations
meta: Several tested-style ad copy versions for your ads, with headlines and angles to compare. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Ad copy variations to test side by side
overview: A single ad rarely tells you what works. We write several versions of your ad copy, each with a different angle such as price, quality, speed or a customer problem, so you can test them against each other. We draft with AI tools and a person trims each line to fit the platform limits and policies. You receive headlines, primary text and calls to action in a sheet, ready to paste into your ad account.

list: Test plan with a simple timeline

faq: Which ad platforms do you write for?
Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest and LinkedIn are common requests. Each platform has different length limits, and we write to those limits, so you do not need to cut lines yourself.
No. This service writes the copy. If you want the campaign set up in your ad account, tell us and we quote it separately. You always keep full control of budget and spend.
Will the ads pass platform review?
We follow each platform's ad policies and avoid banned claims, such as health promises or before and after claims. We cannot control approval decisions, which belong to the ad platform.
Can I use these ads for different products?
Each set is written for the product or offer you name. For another product, order again or add the extra version pack. We reuse your tone, but never copy the same lines across products.
